strings.jp: 骨・脱殻・目があれば…
strings.us:
If only I had a bone, some skin,
and an eye...
strings.en:
If only I had a bone, some skin,
and an eye...

strings.jp: わたしが必要なのは骨・脱殻・目だ、それではない
strings.us:
I need bone, skin, and an eye.
You do not possess what I require.
strings.en:
I need bone, skin, and an eye.
You do not possess what I require.

strings.us:
This is not enough, but it should
do for now.
strings.en:
This is not enough, but it should
do for now.

strings.jp:
できたぞ! あと2人のものが揃えば
やっとあの究極の魔力が手に入る…
strings.us:
Viola! We're two more experiments
away from the ultimate power!
strings.en:
Voila! We're two more experiments
away from the ultimate power!

strings.jp:
できたぞ! あと1人のものが揃えば
やっとあの究極の魔力が手に入る…
strings.us:
Viola! We're one more experiment
away from the ultimate power!
strings.en:
Voila! We're one more experiment
away from the ultimate power!

strings.us: I have all the ingredients I need.
strings.en: I have all the ingredients I need.
